sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Re-ground: verify current position and recompute remaining path
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
adj = seg['adjacency_list']

adj_map = {}
for a, b in adj:
    adj_map.setdefault(a, []).append(b)

stop_ids = {n['id'] for n in nodes if n['color'] in ('W', 'b', 'N')}
transit_ids = {n['id'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'g'}
all_walkable = stop_ids | transit_ids

# Build graph: stop nodes connected via transit paths
graph = {}
for start_id in stop_ids:
    visited = {start_id}
    queue = [start_id]
    while queue:
        current = queue.pop(0)
        for nb in adj_map.get(current, []):
            if nb not in visited and nb in all_walkable:
                visited.add(nb)
                if nb in stop_ids and nb != start_id:
                    graph.setdefault(start_id, []).append(nb)
                    graph.setdefault(nb, []).append(start_id)
                elif nb in transit_ids:
                    queue.append(nb)

blue_id = [n['id'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
green_id = [n['id'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N'][0]

# BFS from current blue to green
import collections
queue = collections.deque([(blue_id, [blue_id])])
visited = {blue_id}
found_path = None
while queue:
    node, path = queue.popleft()
    if node == green_id:
        found_path = path
        break
    for nb in graph.get(node, []):
        if nb not in visited:
            visited.add(nb)
            queue.append((nb, path + [nb]))

if found_path:
    print(f"Path: {len(found_path)-1} moves remaining")
    def center(n):
        b = n['boundary']
        r = sum(p[0] for p in b) / len(b)
        c = sum(p[1] for p in b) / len(b)
        return (r, c)
    
    dirs = []
    for i in range(len(found_path) - 1):
        c1 = center(nodes[found_path[i]])
        c2 = center(nodes[found_path[i+1]])
        dr = c2[0] - c1[0]
        dc = c2[1] - c1[1]
        if abs(dr) > abs(dc):
            d = 'UP' if dr < 0 else 'DOWN'
        else:
            d = 'LEFT' if dc < 0 else 'RIGHT'
        dirs.append(d)
    print(f"Directions: {dirs}")
    
    # Execute remaining path
    result = action(dirs)
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    print(f"Done: {last_action_result.get('done')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
